name: Jack-O’-Lantern
description: Created to ward off evil spirits, their mischievous antics can make them as troublesome as any monster.

abilities.name: Explode
abilities.description: When a jack-o’-lantern is reduced to 0 Hp or the bottom of the Break Gauge, it is not destroyed, but may not take any actions. However, at the start of its next turn, the jack-o’-lantern makes an attack roll (d20+15), at no penalty, against the Ref Defence of all creatures within 4 squares. If successful, creatures suffer 4d6+5 fire damage. Otherwise, creatures take half damage. The jack-o’-lantern is then destroyed. This is an area effect.

abilities.name: Firebolt
abilities.description: As a primary action, a jack-o’-lantern may make an attack (d20+15) against the Ref Defence of a single creature within 6 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target suffers 4d6+5 fire damage. Otherwise, the target takes half damage. Additionally, if the attack roll beat the Ref Defence of any creatures adjacent to the target, they take half that damage. The jack-o’-lantern may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

abilities.name: Imitate
abilities.description: A jack-o’-lantern may take 20 on Stealth checks when remaining still and can hide in plain sight.

abilities.name: Unction
abilities.description: Whenever the jack-o’-lantern’s bite attack beats both a target's Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes oiled.

name: Bag O’ Tricks
description: “Never look a gift bag in the mouth”—for if it has one, you’re already in grave danger.

abilities.name: Imitate
abilities.description: A Bag o’ Tricks may take 20 on Stealth checks when remaining still and can hide in plain sight.

abilities.name: Lockjaw
abilities.description: Whenever a bag o’ tricks successfully hits a creature with its bite attack, the bag o’ tricks may attach itself to the creature if they are larger than the bag o’ tricks. While doing so, the bag o’ tricks shares the creature’s space and there is a 50% chance (50 or less on d%) that any attack, spell, or ability that targets the bag o’ tricks hits the affected creature instead. The bag o’tricks may end this effect as a free action.

name: Phantom Armour
description: Once enchanted sentries for mages, they fell out of use as common folk, fearing necromancy, often hunted them down.

abilities.name: Imitate
abilities.description: A phantom armour may take 20 on Stealth checks when remaining still and can hide in plain sight.

abilities.name: Armoured Form
abilities.description: The phantom armour is treated as proficient in any armour it wears. Additionally, the phantom armour is never treated as encumbered by heavy armour.

loot: Mythril Blade (5%), Iron Cuirass (20%), Heater Shield (50%)

name: Mimic
description: Thieves and treasure hunters beware—a hungry mimic waits to turn you into an early retirement.

abilities.name: Gnaw
abilities.description: Whenever a mimic pins a target, it may make a free bite attack that ignores non-magickal DR.

abilities.name: Imitate
abilities.description: A mimic may take 20 on Stealth checks when remaining still and can hide in plain sight.

abilities.name: Mighty Guard
abilities.description: As a secondary action, the mimic can close the lid on its chest-like body for 1d4+1 turns. While closed, the mimic clears itself of all status effects (except curses) and gains immunity to all status effects (except curses). Additionally, if damaged by melee attacks, half the damage the mimic would suffer is instead dealt to the attacker as unaspected damage. Once this effect ends, the mimic may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

abilities.name: Tongue
abilities.description: The mimic may attempt to grab a creature within 6 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target is immediately moved adjacent to the mimic.

abilities.name: Voracious
abilities.description: When a mimic’s bite attack beats both a target’s Ref and Will Defence, the target loses all positive effects and buffs provided by spells and the mimic gains them. This effect is resolved before damage is rolled.

name: Greedy Grimoire
description: Born from the mad scrawlings of a wizard, this ravenous creature devours all things magical.

abilities.name: Absorb Magick
abilities.description: When a greedy grimoire is affected by a non-blue magick spell, it suffers no effect and instead regains an amount of temporary MP equal to the cost of the spell used. If this temporary MP is not used by the end of the encounter, it is lost.

abilities.name: Imitate
abilities.description: A greedy grimoire may take 20 on Stealth checks when remaining still and can hide in plain sight.

abilities.name: Magickal
abilities.description: Greedy Grimiores gain an amount of MP equal to 3+Mnd each level, and always treat Spellcraft as a class skill.

abilities.name: Spell Thief
abilities.description: Any spell cast within 12 squares and line of sight of the greedy grimoire is then treated as a known spell by the greedy grimoire until the end of the encounter.

abilities.name: Syphon Mana
abilities.description: As a primary action, the greedy grimoire can make a Spellcraft check (d20+20) against the Will Defence of a single creature within 12 squares and line of sight. If successful, the target loses 3d6 MP and the greedy grimoire gains an equal amount of MP . These dice may explode. The greedy grimoire may not use this ability again for 1d4+1 turns.

name: Golem, Stone
description: Forged by ancient dwarves with lost rune magic, these stone sentinels guard the Highlands.

abilities.name: Granite Punch
abilities.description: Whenever the stone golem’s slam attack beats both a target’s Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes flat-footed and may take no actions until the start of the stone golem’s next turn. This is a stun.

abilities.name: Immovable
abilities.description: The stone golem cannot be moved by any means of forced movement, including teleportation.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when the stone golem would be moved down the Break Gauge, the stone golem can choose to not move down the Break Gauge.

name: Golem, Iron
description: Ancient dwarven war machines, abandoned after a lost war, now roaming on long-forgotten orders.

abilities.name: Granite Punch
abilities.description: Whenever the iron golem’s slam attack beats both a target’s Ref and Fort Defence, the target becomes flat-footed and may take no actions the start of the iron golem’s next turn. This is a stun.

abilities.name: Immovable
abilities.description: The iron golem cannot be moved by any means of forced movement, including teleportation.

abilities.name: Steadfast
abilities.description: Once per encounter, when the iron golem would be moved down the Break Gauge, the iron golem can choose to not move down the Break Gauge.

name: Gorgon
description: Malevolent guardians commissioned by Lilith’s daughters to protect her tomb and bloodline.

abilities.name: Bulldoze
abilities.description: The gorgon is treated as having the Trample technick and is treated as both mount and rider while charging. Additionally, any creature the gorgon tramples is knocked prone, even if they took half damage.

abilities.name: Butcher’s Grip
abilities.description: Gorgons may treat large weapons as 2-handed weapons, despite their size.

abilities.name: Fire Breath
abilities.description: As a primary action, a gorgon can make an attack (d20+21) against the Ref Defence of all creatures within a 6 square cone. If successful, targets take 8d6+11 fire damage.

abilities.name: Unction
abilities.description: Whenever the gorgon’s gore attack beats both a creature’s Ref and Fort Defence, the creature becomes oiled.
